data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'lexis', meaning 'word' or 'promise'. In Greek mythology, the god Helios was sworn by an oath to the goddess Eos, which was called 'lishe'. In Christianity, this name represents a promise or oath made to God. The name Lishe carries the meaning “God's Oath” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lishe usually hope their child will grow to embody god's oath and live with faith, good character and purpose.
